facts.fact: A second cohort of 50 young people began D-CLIC digital-skills training at Aneho in August 2026, backed by nearly CFAF 300 million from OIF since 2025.
In April 2025, 244 young Togolese received certificates after five months of D-CLIC training in Lome, Aneho, Kara and Dapaong, per Togo First.
